# Header fixtures

Two problem files of TPTP v9.3.1, copied verbatim from `Problems/` of the
distribution at <https://tptp.org/TPTP/Distribution/TPTP-v9.3.1.tgz>. Both are
TPTP material, attributed to the TPTP, whose terms permit verbatim redistribution
so attributed; see `NOTICE`. Neither is edited.

| File | Why it is here |
|---|---|
| `PUZ001+1.p` | Every form a header line takes: keys, wrapped prose (`English`), `%          :` entries (`Refs`, `Comments`), the `Syntax` counts, and empty lines between groups. |
| `MGT087+1.p` | One of the four files whose `Refs`, `Source` and `Names` lines have no colon, which `Tptp.Header` reports as `TPTP0901`. The others are `MGT088+1.p`, `MGT105+1.p` and `MGT108+1.p`. |
